# mewa_ui

mewa_ui is a framework-free UI library of semantic HTML, tokenized CSS, local SVG icons, and small native-first ES modules. Use the current `src/`, `components/`, `docs/`, `layouts/`, `registry.json`, and this guide only.

## Source of truth

1. `src/base.css` defines static foundations, Geist fonts, typography, geometry, spacing, browser defaults, and palette primitives.
2. `src/tokens.css` defines light and dark semantic roles for surfaces, text, borders, and charts.
3. `components/{slug}/{slug}.md` is the markup contract. Its Native basis, structure, attributes, ARIA, keyboard, and fallback notes are authoritative.
4. `components/{slug}/{slug}.css` is the component stylesheet. `components/{slug}/{slug}.js`, when present, is the component module.
5. `docs/{slug}.html` is the static reference page for the same component. It is a usage reference, not a second implementation source.
6. `registry.json` is the machine-readable inventory. Match by `slug`, and use its `requiresJs`, `enhancementJs`, `files`, `docs`, and `nativeBasis` fields.
7. `components/app-shell/` contains reusable application chrome primitives. `layouts/` contains the two complete reusable shell templates, with `layouts/layouts.css` and `layouts/layouts.js` as layout-local assets.

Do not infer an API from a similarly named library. If a class, attribute, variant, or behavior is not in the matching skill and implementation, do not use it.

## Naming and asset loading

- Use the registry's title-case `name` in prose and its lowercase kebab-case `slug` in paths. `Table` is the structural table. `Data Table` is its optional filtering, sorting, status, and pagination enhancement. `Date Field` uses native date inputs. `Date Picker` is the custom month grid.
- Load the foundations in this order, before component CSS:

  ```html
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/ui/src/base.css">
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/ui/src/tokens.css">
  ```

- Load only the stylesheet for each component used:

  ```html
  <link rel="stylesheet" href="/ui/components/{slug}/{slug}.css">
  ```

- Load a component module only when `registry.json` says `requiresJs: true`, or when an optional `enhancementJs: true` mode is wanted:

  ```html
  <script type="module" src="/ui/components/{slug}/{slug}.js"></script>
  ```

- Icons are local files under `src/icons/`. Inline the matching SVG for the no-JavaScript path. A local loader may optionally expand the documented `data-lucide` hook, but it is a documentation or embedding concern, not a required component module. Never use a remote icon CDN.
- Decorative icons need `aria-hidden="true"`. Icon-only controls need a visible or programmatic accessible name.
- There is no framework, package runtime, generated snippet catalog, or production build step to add.

## Component catalog

Every item links to its current documentation page and the machine-readable registry. Search `registry.json` for the shown `slug` to read the complete entry.

### Primitives

- **Typography** (`typography`) — [docs](docs/typography.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native headings, prose, quotes, code, keyboard notation, and lists.
- **Layout** (`layout`) — [docs](docs/layout.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Intrinsic Grid and Flexbox containers, stacks, grids, splits, and centering.
- **Separator** (`separator`) — [docs](docs/separator.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Horizontal rules and vertical visual divisions.
- **Icon** (`icon`) — [docs](docs/icon.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Inline local Lucide SVG presentation with an optional loader hook and no required component JavaScript.

### Actions

- **Button** (`button`) — [docs](docs/button.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Semantic actions and link-style button variants.
- **Toggle** (`toggle`) — [docs](docs/toggle.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Two-state buttons exposing `aria-pressed`.
- **Toggle Group** (`toggle-group`) — [docs](docs/toggle-group.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Single or multiple pressed-button selection with roving focus.
- **Button Group** (`button-group`) — [docs](docs/button-group.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Connected groups of related buttons.
- **Toolbar** (`toolbar`) — [docs](docs/toolbar.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Keyboard-navigable groups of controls.

### Forms and inputs

- **Label** (`label`) — [docs](docs/label.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Explicit native label and control association.
- **Field** (`field`) — [docs](docs/field.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Labelled control and fieldset composition with descriptions and errors.
- **Text Field** (`text-field`) — [docs](docs/text-field.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Labelled native input composition with validation.
- **Textarea** (`textarea`) — [docs](docs/textarea.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native multi-line text input with content-sized growth.
- **Checkbox** (`checkbox`) — [docs](docs/checkbox.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native checked and indeterminate checkbox control.
- **Radio Group** (`radio-group`) — [docs](docs/radio-group.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Mutually exclusive radios in a named fieldset.
- **Switch** (`switch`) — [docs](docs/switch.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Binary setting using a checkbox with switch semantics.
- **Slider** (`slider`) — [docs](docs/slider.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native range input with horizontal and vertical presentation.
- **Select** (`select`) — [docs](docs/select.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native select and optgroup styling.
- **Number Field** (`number-field`) — [docs](docs/number-field.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native number input with increment and decrement controls.
- **File Input** (`file-input`) — [docs](docs/file-input.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native file picker with styled selector button.
- **Date Field** (`date-field`) — [docs](docs/date-field.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native date or datetime input and browser picker.
- **Date Picker** (`date-picker`) — [docs](docs/date-picker.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Accessible custom month grid with date navigation.
- **Date Range Picker** (`date-range-picker`) — [docs](docs/date-range-picker.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native start and end date inputs with optional cross-field checks.
- **Combobox** (`combobox`) — [docs](docs/combobox.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Searchable popover listbox with keyboard selection.
- **Time Field** (`time-field`) — [docs](docs/time-field.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native time segments with optional synchronized submission.
- **Form** (`form`) — [docs](docs/form.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native form layout, labels, descriptions, errors, and validation.

### Data display

- **Badge** (`badge`) — [docs](docs/badge.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Non-interactive status or metadata indicator.
- **Avatar** (`avatar`) — [docs](docs/avatar.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Image, fallback, badge, and avatar-group presentation.
- **Card** (`card`) — [docs](docs/card.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Grouped or standalone content container.
- **Image** (`image`) — [docs](docs/image.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Figure, caption, sizing, fallback, and lightbox presentation.
- **Statistic** (`statistic`) — [docs](docs/statistic.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Value, label, and trend summary.
- **Table** (`table`) — [docs](docs/table.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Structural semantic table with caption and scoped headers.
- **Data Table** (`data-table`) — [docs](docs/data-table.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Optional filtering, sorting, result status, and native pagination around Table.
- **Collapsible** (`collapsible`) — [docs](docs/collapsible.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native details disclosure.
- **Timeline** (`timeline`) — [docs](docs/timeline.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Ordered events with connected markers.
- **Tree View** (`tree-view`) — [docs](docs/tree-view.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Hierarchical tree and keyboard branch navigation.
- **Carousel** (`carousel`) — [docs](docs/carousel.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Scroll-snap slides with controls and active indicators.
- **Scroll Area** (`scroll-area`) — [docs](docs/scroll-area.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Bounded overflow and scrollbar styling.
- **Sortable** (`sortable`) — [docs](docs/sortable.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native drag-and-drop and keyboard reordering.

### Feedback and status

- **Spinner** (`spinner`) — [docs](docs/spinner.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Static loading status indicator.
- **Skeleton** (`skeleton`) — [docs](docs/skeleton.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Static loading placeholder.
- **Progress** (`progress`) — [docs](docs/progress.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native bounded completion indicator.
- **Callout** (`callout`) — [docs](docs/callout.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Important alert content region.
- **Alert Dialog** (`alert-dialog`) — [docs](docs/alert-dialog.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Explicit-response modal confirmation.
- **Toast** (`toast`) — [docs](docs/toast.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Top-layer live status notification.

### Overlays

- **Popover** (`popover`) — [docs](docs/popover.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native Popover API surface with anchored placement.
- **Tooltip** (`tooltip`) — [docs](docs/tooltip.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Hover and focus hint popup using `popover="hint"`.
- **Dialog** (`dialog`) — [docs](docs/dialog.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native modal dialog with focus restoration.
- **Sheet** (`sheet`) — [docs](docs/sheet.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Edge-aligned dialog variant.
- **Accordion** (`accordion`) — [docs](docs/accordion.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native multi-open disclosure with optional single-open enhancement.
- **Command Palette** (`command-palette`) — [docs](docs/command-palette.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Modal command search and keyboard activation.

### Navigation

- **Breadcrumbs** (`breadcrumbs`) — [docs](docs/breadcrumbs.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Ordered hierarchical route trail.
- **Pagination** (`pagination`) — [docs](docs/pagination.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Native page links in a navigation landmark.
- **Tabs** (`tabs`) — [docs](docs/tabs.html) · [registry](registry.json) — ARIA tabs with keyboard panel switching.
- **Dropdown Menu** (`dropdown-menu`) — [docs](docs/dropdown-menu.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Popover menu with keyboard item management.
- **Navigation Menu** (`navigation-menu`) — [docs](docs/navigation-menu.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Site routes with popover dropdown groups.

### Application

- **App Shell** (`app-shell`) — [docs](docs/app-shell.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Shared header, toolbar, page-overview, status, empty-state, and optional OS-aware theme primitives.
- **Sidebar** (`sidebar`) — [docs](docs/sidebar.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Collapsible desktop rail and mobile navigation dialog.
- **Resizable** (`resizable`) — [docs](docs/resizable.html) · [registry](registry.json) — Two-panel split with a static separator and optional pointer and keyboard resizing.

## JavaScript and progressive enhancement

- `requiresJs: true` means the documented interaction depends on the module. Load the matching `.js` file after the markup. Required modules include keyboard coordination, filtering, custom calendar navigation, modal trigger wiring, anchored overlays, drag reordering, and live status behavior.
- `enhancementJs: true` means the native markup is complete without the module. Load the module only for the documented enhancement. The current optional entries are Accordion, App Shell, Checkbox, Data Table, Date Range Picker, Resizable, and Time Field.
- Entries with `requiresJs: false`, `enhancementJs: false`, and no `files.js` are CSS and native HTML components. Do not add a runtime just to reproduce their behavior.
- Keep native links, form submission, browser validation, disclosure, date controls, and dialog or popover semantics useful when a module is omitted. Server-rendered validation and navigation remain authoritative.
- Component modules use modern ES modules and are intended to tolerate repeated loading and markup inserted after navigation. Do not replace them with a framework, polling loop, focus-trap package, or positioning package.

## Accessibility and motion

- Start with the documented native element. Keep visible labels, stable `id` values, `for` associations, descriptions, error references, accessible names, and `aria-*` relationships intact.
- Use links for navigation and buttons for actions. Preserve native `disabled`, `readonly`, `required`, `hidden`, `open`, `min`, `max`, `step`, `aria-current`, `aria-sort`, and `role="status"` state where the skill specifies them.
- Every pointer or drag path needs the documented keyboard path. Use live output or status text when a resize, reorder, filter, or navigation result is not otherwise apparent.
- Keep `:focus-visible`, `prefers-contrast: more`, `forced-colors: active`, and narrow-width behavior usable. Do not communicate state with color alone.
- The canonical source is motionless. Do not add `animation`, `transition`, smooth scrolling, View Transitions, scroll-driven effects, Web Animations, shimmer, or spinning loaders. State changes, disclosures, overlays, tabs, drag updates, and navigation are immediate.
- Geometry is square by default. Use semantic token roles from `src/tokens.css`. Do not add shadows, shadow tokens, visual elevation halos, or a general radius scale. Circular geometry is reserved for meaningful circular objects.

## API boundary

Use only classes and `data-*` hooks documented by the matching component skill and implementation. Do not invent classes, undocumented `data-*` hooks, token names, compatibility aliases, or undocumented variants. Do not copy paths from another source tree, generate duplicate CSS or JavaScript snippets, or introduce a second source tree.
